workflow: Illustrated prepayment value preview and published member overview share original blue care artwork, three-dimensional service symbols and functional programme/document/coordination cards. Progress comes from each record’s action history, not invented health scores.

retainedComponentEvidence.scope: Unchanged API/service workflows, seeded corpus, urgent guidance and geographic snapshot retain prior evidence. They were not all rerun. Current affected browser navigation, member UI, isolation, documents and visual interactions were checked.

limits: Both spaces remain browser-local synthetic demos; no production payments, SMS or shared persistent backend.
Completion percentages measure reported actions, not health improvement.
One-year sample history does not define the duration included in each purchase.
Standalone prepayment page remains an independent design preview; no real medical assessment or purchase is performed.
Facility listings remain a dated Geoapify snapshot with Neshan directions; no live gateway deployment.
publication: Public HTTPS readback is recorded independently in ux-publication.json.
